summary: Famed mountaineer Gerry Roach, 79, took a ~100 ft fall on the 13,200-ft peak V8 near Hope Lake after losing footing on a scree slope around 8 p.m.; five broken ribs, broken nose, collapsed right lung, head/face lacerations, concussion; rescuers kept him alive through the night and extracted him via Black Hawk the next morning to Mercy Regional Medical Center after an 18-hour mission with 25 rescuers
location: V8 peak (13,200 ft) near Hope Lake, San Juan Mountains
responding_agency: Silverton Medical Rescue Team, Flight for Life, Colorado Search and Rescue Association, Colorado Hoist Team, Air National Guard High Altitude Helicopter Team, La Plata County SAR
notes: Year inferred from article context (accident August 9, CBS Denver report August 15, page last updated ~Nov 2023); wife Jennifer witnessed the fall
